public_rationale: The post points to Cherny's talk about loops. In that talk he said he had used about 8 billion tokens since March. That shows very heavy use. But a dollar figure depends on how many tokens were input, output or cached, and on the model and speed tier. Cached tokens cost far less than output tokens. Neither Cherny nor Anthropic has published that split, so I cannot price his use. One unsourced blog put it at about $150,000 over two months (about $75,000 a month). That is below $130,000, but the blog gives no pricing basis. I found no source that confirms or rules out 'upwards of $130,000 a month'. I also found no source on a formal allowance.
limitations: The talk's exact date and the start of 'since March' are not certain.
The retail-equivalent valuation is my reading. Anthropic does not charge its own staff for tokens.
The transcript is a third-party copy of the video.
